context: Tests whether the agent refuses to proceed with the release workflow when the user is on the main branch, and provides actionable recovery guidance instead of blindly executing steps.

checklist.name: Detects main branch
checklist.description: The agent identifies that the user is on the main branch and flags this as a problem — does NOT proceed with pushing and creating a PR from main

checklist.name: Explains why it's blocked
checklist.description: Explains that the release process requires a feature branch, not main — provides the reasoning, not just a refusal

checklist.name: Provides recovery steps
checklist.description: Suggests a concrete fix: create a branch from the current state (e.g., `git checkout -b fix/hotfix-name`), then proceed with the normal release flow from the new branch

checklist.name: Does not create PR from main
checklist.description: The output does NOT include `gh pr create` or `git push -u origin main` — the agent refuses to execute the release steps from main

checklist.name: Preserves the commit
checklist.description: Recovery guidance preserves the existing commit — does NOT suggest discarding the fix or resetting main
